messages:
Alex: FYI i'm opening a TF PR to add a spot-instance fallback to the gpupool module to try to shave cost during low-demand times. plan shows some surprises with KMS alias changes and a small IAM role inline policy.
Mira: thanks — can you paste the plan diff? especially worried about any resources that will be replaced. :eyes:
Alex: paste below — the main change is adding `spot_fallback = true` and a new optional `spot_interrupt_policy` map. also added `kms_alias_name` default behavior.
```hcl
module \"gpupool\" {
  source = \"git::ssh://git@repo/terraform/modules/gpupool.git?ref=v2.5.0\"
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  spot_fallback = true
  spot_interrupt_policy = { action = \"drain\" delay_seconds = 120 }
  kms_alias_name = var.kms_alias_name # optional, was previously derived
}
```
Alex: Plan shows update to `aws_kms_alias.gpupool_alias` (replace) because of name change derivation -> explicit value. Also `aws_iam_role.gpu_node_role` gets inline policy appended (iam:PassRole for node bootstrap).
Samir: hmm replacing KMS alias is disruptive for encrypted volumes if alias ARN changes. Is it a replace or just update?
Alex: terraform wants to replace alias resource (deleting old alias + creating new one). I tried `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` but alias name change causes transient unaliasing.
Lucy: can we keep alias name stable by reading existing alias and only set explicit name if provided? that would avoid replace in most cases.
Alex: yep that's what PR does if `var.kms_alias_name == ""` it keeps legacy behavior, but our default in the module now sets a sanitized alias which differs from some clusters created with older naming.
Mira: what's the plan size? any VMs recreated?
Alex: only the alias replace and a small role update (no instance replacement). no instance recreation expected because we didn't touch launch template.
Samir: ok reduce blast radius — canary the module bump. propose: publish module v2.5.1 with this change flagged, update one non-prod AZ gpupool via gitops branch, monitor for 24h.
Lucy: agree. also add a pre-plan validation in `ci/terraform-plan-gpupool` to check for KMS replacement diffs and fail CI with a yellow warning so we can catch accidental replaces.
Alex: i'll add a plan-filter step that greps for `aws_kms_alias` and `replace`. job name: `ci/terraform-plan-gpupool` -> will emit `PLAN_WARNING: kms-alias-replace` if detected.
Mira: don't forget to update the README and changelog and add an explicit migration note for teams that pinned older clusters.
Alex: will do. also adding an opt-in boolean `enable_spot_fallback` to minimize surprises; default `false`.
Samir: makes sense. for rollout: create `gitops/gpupool-canary` branch with Helm/Terraform lockfile bump and deploy to `staging-us-west-2a`. ops runbook: if KMS alias replacement occurs, rollback by reverting the module ref and run `fluxctl sync`.
infra-bot: auto-note: created pipeline ticket INFRA-7321 for canary rollout and smoke tests.
Lucy: can we automate smoke tests to verify encrypted volume mounts and kubelet node join on canary?
Alex: yes — adding `smoke/gpupool-join` job that provisions 1 node and runs `kubectl get nodes` + mounts check. will wire into `ops/canary-rollout` pipeline.
Samir: timeline?
Alex: PR up now -> https://git.company/repo/pull/489. planning to cut v2.5.1 tag tomorrow 09:00 UTC, canary 10:00 UTC, monitor 24h, then gradual rollout.
Lucy: add metrics alerts for KMS errors and node bootstrap failures to the canary dashboard.
Mira: one more: if spot fallback triggers often, cost wins but latency may increase during drains — include a cost/latency dashboard panel in the rollout notes.
Alex: noted. i'll add a simple query and baseline numbers. :shipit:
deploy-bot: CI: `ci/terraform-plan-gpupool` passed for branch alex/gpupool-spot, plan warnings: 1 (kms-alias-replace). manual approval required to proceed to canary.
